permit.applies: The noncitizen worker applies for the alien worker's entry permit, on an employment contract that complies with the national employment laws.
permit.first: A contract of employment with an employer in the FSM.
permit.validityNote: For the period the contract authorises the employment, renewed upon extension or renewal of the lawful employment status (FSM Code title 50, s. 103, as read in layer 3 and as reproduced in C.B. 21-118).

sources.title: Congress of the FSM, C.B. No. 21-118 (2020), a bill to amend title 50, ss. 103–104 (reproducing s. 103 with the proposed changes)
sources.said: A visitor’s permit for any lawful purpose, 14 including performance of necessary services on a short-term 15 contractual basis, may be issued for a period of specified 16 duration reflecting the time necessary to accomplish the 17 purpose. … alien worker’s permit shall be issued to a 21 noncitizen entering the Federated States of Micronesia upon 22 compliance with all National laws relating to private or 23 governmental employment for the period in which the employment 24 of the alien worker is authorized by contract. The permit 25 … shall be renewed upon extension or renewal of the alien’s 1 lawful employment status. … The amount of the fee required for an alien 3 worker’s permit, which shall not be less than $1,000 shall be 4 set forth in regulations

sources.title: Congress of the FSM, Public Law No. 22-159 (14 October 2022)
sources.said: except that the provisions of this 9 chapter shall not apply to private sector 10 employees who are brought into the Federated 11 States of Micronesia for the purposes of private 12 sector employment. The exception for private 13 sector employment under this Chapter shall expire 14 on September 30, 2027.
